reason: The company faces a production halt at a key facility due to quality lapses, which will directly impact revenue and margins for its eye-care product line.
why_now: The exchange has officially sought clarification on the production halt as of 2026-11-04, confirming the regulatory risk is active.
source_headlines: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited: The Exchange has sought clarification from Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited with respect to recent news item captioned India orders Sun Pharma to halt eye-care drug production at plant after quality lapses. The response from the Company is attached.
